name: Actor filters by Hand Tools category
scenarioId: classpath:features/product_catalog:Actor filters by Hand Tools category
methodName: Actor filters by Hand Tools category

testSteps.description: Given Actor is on the home page

When Actor selects following categories:
| Hand Saw |
| Hammer |

Then the following products are shown:
| Product | Price |
| Claw Hammer with Shock Reduction Grip | $13.41 |
| Hammer | $12.58 |
| Claw Hammer | $11.48 |
| Thor Hammer | $11.14 |
| Sledgehammer | $17.75 |
| Claw Hammer with Fiberglass Handle | $20.14 |
| Court Hammer | $18.63 |
| Wood Saw | $12.18 |

userStory.narrative:
As a customer,
  I want to easily search, filter, and sort products in the catalog
  So that I can find what I need quickly

title: Actor filters by Hand Tools category

rule.name: Customer should be able to filter by category
